title: [UI][Sorting] Name sort options order all six products in both directions
precondition: Standard user is logged in and is on the Products page showing the default order (Name A to Z). Price sorting is covered by SD-T-404 and SD-T-405.

steps.expected: The dropdown shows "Name (Z to A)" and the products are listed in this order: Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red), Sauce Labs Onesie, Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket, Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt, Sauce Labs Bike Light, Sauce Labs Backpack

The dropdown shows "Name (A to Z)" and the original order is restored: Sauce Labs Backpack, Sauce Labs Bike Light, Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt, Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket, Sauce Labs Onesie, Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)

gherkin:
Given I am on the Products page with the default order
When I select "Name (Z to A)"
Then the six products are listed in reverse alphabetical order
When I select "Name (A to Z)"
Then the original alphabetical order is restored
